info.text:
Diesel and transportation added over $2 billion in incremental costs for Walmart this year, its CFO said on Thursday's earnings call.
U.S. diesel averaged $5.94 a gallon in the latest EIA weekly survey (Nov 16), versus $3.87 a year ago.
Walmart's Q3 revenue still rose 5.2% to $188.8B, and it raised its full-year outlook for the third time this year.
Nearly $3 billion in tariff refunds helped offset costs, and Walmart cites about 7,700 U.S. rollbacks. But its CEO says pricing depends on transportation and input costs.
Sources: Walmart Q3 FY27 release and call (Nov 19, 2026), EIA, Reuters, CNBC, AP.
News and education, not financial advice.
